description: Animation steps 1 and 2 correspond to the two before-deletion columns of the connection table. The last step corresponds to the two after-deletion columns. Use the node row headings to look up the connections in either state.
prose.result: Values 2 through 15 remain in binary search tree order. The empty position to the left of 2 represents a None reference, not a new node.

steps.announcement: Follow the left branch to target node 1 and its parent, 2.
steps.explanation: The target 1 is less than 8, 4, and 2. Follow 8→4→2→1 to reach cur=1 with pre=2. Node 1 is still the left child of 2, and 3 is its right child. Nothing has been deleted yet. See the two before-deletion columns in “Binary search tree connections before and after deleting a leaf” for the whole tree.
steps.key_state: With cur = 1 and pre = 2, the target has been found but has yet to be deleted.
steps.title: Locate the leaf to delete

steps.announcement: Confirm that target node 1 has degree 0. The parent link is still intact.
steps.explanation: Both child references of cur (1) are empty, confirming its degree is 0 and there is no subtree to reconnect. So far only the check is complete. Node 1 is still in place: pre=2, and 2 still has left child 1 and right child 3. The whole tree still matches the two before-deletion columns of the same table.
steps.key_state: Node 1 has degree 0 and is still in place. Parent 2 still has left child 1 and right child 3.
steps.title: Confirm the target has no children

steps.announcement: Set parent 2's left reference to None to finish deleting leaf 1.
steps.explanation: Set pre.left = None to detach leaf 1. The root remains 8. Node 2 has no left child and has right leaf 3. All other connections stay the same, and the tree retains values 2 through 15. The two after-deletion columns of the same table now describe the whole tree, with the cells for node 1 marked “Removed.”
steps.key_state: Node 2's left reference is None, and its right child is 3. Leaf 1 has been detached, leaving values 2 through 15.
steps.title: Clear the parent's left link

prose.summary: A leaf has degree 0, so there is no subtree to reconnect. Simply clear the parent's reference to the leaf.
